cards.title: Why child rudeness annoys parents
cards.body: A reader explores why repetitive phrases like 'Na-na, na-na-na' from children can be particularly grating. The question touches on normal childhood behavior and parental patience.

cards.title: Managing partner behavior at kids' sports
cards.body: A parent seeks advice about their partner's obnoxious conduct at their sons' football matches. An expert suggests exploring the root causes of the anger rather than focusing only on the inappropriate behavior.

cards.title: Human connection matters more than screens
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection poses a bigger threat to children than AI or technology. The solution lies in open conversation and spending quality time talking with kids.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for kids
cards.body: A parent embraces Halloween traditions to create moments of magic and connection with their children. Celebrating autumn through these activities strengthens family bonds and creates lasting memories.

cards.title: Our memorial garden helps us grieve
cards.body: Emma Moore shares how creating a special memorial space at home helped her family process grief. The garden provides a more personal alternative to traditional cemetery memorials.
